label: DrayTek Vigor130 VDSL2/ADSL2+ bridge modem
description: Compact VDSL2 (profiles up to 30a, 100 Mbit/s downlink) / ADSL2+ modem that runs as a full DSL-to-Ethernet bridge in front of a third-party firewall or router, with one RJ-11 line port and a single gigabit Ethernet LAN port.
notes: DrayTek datasheet: '1 x VDSL2/ADSL2/2+ port, RJ-11 (Annex A) or RJ-45 (Annex B)', '1 x 10/100/1000 Base-Tx LAN port', VDSL2 profiles 8a/8b/8c/8d/12a/12b/17a/30a (no 35b), 'Router/Bridge Configurable'. One-gigabit LAN port next to a 100M 30a line is correct: the Ethernet port is gigabit, the DSL line is not.
